Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we move toward procurement approval, our InfoSec team needs a completed SIG spreadsheet (control-level answers) and supporting artifacts: the most recent SOC 2 report, pen test executive summary, ISO statements of applicability, and a short security overview deck we can share with our security review board.

Can you confirm:
- When you can deliver a completed SIG (we'd prefer the detailed/annotated version, not just yes/no)
- Which artifacts you will provide and whether any need an NDA/secure link

We aim to present to our board on Friday, 13 May. If you can't meet that, let us know the earliest possible date.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call if that helps.

Best,

Head of Vendor Security
Delta Health Systems

Laura — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver the annotated SIG and the requested artifacts. Proposed plan:

1) Today (EOD PT): share a prefilled SIG draft for your review (control-level answers with references).
2) Wed 10 May: upload the SOC 2 report (redacted routing), pentest executive summary, and ISO statements to a secure Drive folder; share link with your security_ops address and a DocuSign access request if you require an access agreement.
3) Thu 11 May: send a short (6-slide) security overview deck oriented to your board; include top risks + mitigations and scope of SOC 2.

Notes/constraints:
- The full pen test artifacts include vulnerability scan outputs that we don't share externally; we will provide an executive summary and remediation status.
- SOC 2: we can share the full report under a standard NDA or via our secure view-only portal. If you prefer a redacted PDF in Drive, we'll provide that immediately.

Action item for internal team (CC'd): Marissa — can you own preparing the annotated SIG and assemble the attachments? Karthik — please confirm whether we need a DocuSign NDA before uploading the SOC 2 (I recall Delta asked for an NDA historically).

Laura — if that timeline works, we'll push the initial SIG draft today.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni

Thanks Vivek — I'll take point on the SIG and bundle the artifacts. Quick checklist for our upload: 

- SIG: fill control-level answers in Delta's template + column with evidence pointers (e.g., link to SOC 2 section, policy doc).
- SOC 2: produce a redacted PDF (remove customer-specific sections) and mark source as "view-only" in Drive.
- Pen test: executive summary PDF + remediation tracker (summary CSV).
- ISO: include Statement of Applicability and scope doc (PDF).
- Deck: 6 slides, exec-friendly, one slide for scope + environment (hosted vs dedicated vs private).

Karthik — confirm whether Security can sign the standard Redwood disclosure NDA, or does Delta require their template? If Delta's template, we'll route via DocuSign; otherwise we'll use our standard one and share immediately.

ETA: I'll upload the Drive folder by 17:00 PT and share link with Laura & security_ops.

-Marissa
